databaseSetup.title: Database Setup Required
databaseSetup.description: Initialize your RSS Reader database to get started
databaseSetup.alert: Your Supabase database needs to be initialized before you can use the RSS Reader. Follow the steps below to set up your database.

steps.runScriptDescription: Click the Run Script button below to execute the database initialization script. This will create all necessary tables and indexes.
steps.verifyDescription: After running the script, click Check Database to verify that everything is set up correctly.

databaseSetup.noteDescription: You can find the database script in the Scripts section. The script will create tables for folders, feeds, articles, and settings with proper indexes and relationships.
